newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hydrocarbon column in offshore well - Tap.
newsitem.headline: Hydrocarbon column in offshore well - Tap.

text.p: Tap Oil NL said the Woollybutt One exploration well near the Barrow Island field off the Western Australian coast appeared to contain a hydrocarbon column.
"Gas shows and minor fluorescence were observed in the objective reservoir while drilling and accordingly wire line logs are being run," Tap Oil said.
"Initial log interpretation indicates the presence of a hydrocarbon column, however it is not clear at this stage as to its nature or extent," it said.
The well is now at its total depth of 2,642 metres, after drilling from 2,497 metres since April 21, Tap said.
Further testing will be conducted on the well, which is 44 km west of Barrow Island.

Mobil Exploration and Producing Australia Pty Ltd is the well's operator with a 20 percent stake, while PanCanadian Petroleum International Ltd has 40 percent, Hardy Petroleum Ltd 30 percent, and Tap has 10 percent.
